 Her most recent lab value is above the critical titer threshold for your laboratory.  What is the next
step? Answer Choices: (A) Recommend delivery at 32 weeks gestation (B) Repeat anti-D titers in 1
week (C) Initiate maternal plasmapheresis (D) Recommend corticosteroids for fetal lung maturity, then
immediate delivery (E) Administer corticosteroids to the mother (F) Order peak systolic velocity of the
fetal middle cerebral artery (G) Monitor fetal heart rate variability with continuous cardiotocography (H)
Recommend repeat titer in 4 weeks (I) Perform a cordocentesis to assess fetal hemoglobin (J)
Schedule an immediate amniocentesis

B. Initiate maternal plasmapheresis
C. Repeat anti-D titers in 1 week
D. Recommend repeat titer in 4 weeks

F. Monitor fetal heart rate variability with continuous cardiotocography
